title: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
description: Completed the Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) course from DeepLearning.AI, gaining hands-on expertise in building systems that combine large language models with external knowledge sources for more accurate, context-aware responses. The course covered core RAG concepts including document chunking, embedding generation, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines, along with techniques to reduce hallucinations and improve factual grounding in LLM outputs. I learned to design end-to-end RAG architectures, evaluate retrieval quality, and optimize prompt-context integration for production-ready applications. This strengthens my transition from full-stack development into AI/LLM engineering, equipping me to build intelligent, knowledge-grounded applications using modern generative AI tools and frameworks.
short_description: Certified in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) by DeepLearning.AI, covering embeddings, vector search, and retrieval pipelines to build accurate, knowledge-grounded LLM applications — a key step toward becoming an AI/LLM engineer.
